stem: What is the most common cause of burns in children under 4 years of age?
explanation: Scalds and contact burns are the most common cause of burns in children under 4 years because toddlers are frequently injured by hot liquids and hot surfaces in the home.

optionExplanations.A: Correct because young children commonly sustain burns from hot drinks, food, baths, and touching hot surfaces.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because flame burns are less common than scald and contact injuries in children under 4 years.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because chemical burns are a recognised hazard but are not the leading cause in this age group.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because electrical injuries occur, but they are much less common than scalds and contact burns in toddlers.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because sunburn can cause skin injury, but it is not the most common cause of burns in children under 4 years.

source.hint: Think about common household accidents involving hot liquids or touching hot stoves.
